UK Neet number falls below a million, still near its highest in a decade

The number of young people across the UK not in education, employment or training (Neet) has decreased to below a million. The latest figure remains close to its highest level in a decade. Andy Burnham's government is pushing to tackle the youth jobs crisis, and ministers are preparing sweeping changes in response to Alan Milburn's report.
